scene_description: A classroom scene showing a female teacher standing at a green chalkboard with math multiplication problems written on it. Several children are seated at desks with their hands raised. The teacher appears to be calling on students.

questions.question: Who is standing at the chalkboard?
questions.sentence_frame: The ___ is standing at the chalkboard.
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the person standing up near the big green board.

questions.question: What are the kids doing with their hands?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the children sitting at the desks and what their arms are doing.

questions.question: Where is the teacher standing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is right behind the teacher.

questions.question: What is the chalkboard used for in school?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is written on the big green board.

questions.question: What might the teacher do next when she sees the kids' hands up?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the kids raising their hands and think about what teachers do when that happens.

optional_extension_questions.question: Do you raise your hand at school?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about what you do in your classroom.
